title: LTX-2 gains image-to-video input
summary:
LTX-2 learned image-to-video, four community apps joined the catalog, and image errors got more useful.

LTX-2 now accepts an image through the `image` parameter to generate video from a starting frame. Text-to-video requests keep their existing path.

The community catalog added a trip planner, a mood-board maker, an Indonesian web-development tutor, and a YouTube metadata translator, bringing the Greenhouse count to 743. The README’s Latest News was also refreshed with earlier updates; that edit did not change the underlying services.

Failed image URL downloads and upstream image requests now return more specific error details instead of generic messages or an empty `{}`. Vertex image responses also retain all Gemini text parts, so refusals no longer begin mid-sentence.

highlights.title: Turn images into video
highlights.text: Give `ltx-2` an image through the `image` parameter to generate video from a starting frame. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=ltx-2).

highlights.title: A four-hour traffic view
highlights.text: Model Monitor now has a 4h window for spotting traffic changes that get lost between the 1h and 24h views. [Open Model Monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).
